units.title: DC Generator
topics: 1.1. Various parts of DC machine like yoke, winding, commutators, brushes,lap and wave winding,etc.
1.2. Basic principle of DC Generator, Flemings right hand rule.
1.3. Separately excited, self excited-particularly shunt, series and compound wound type generator.
1.4. E.M.F.equation of generator and various losses in generator.
1.5. No-load, internal and external characteristics
1.6. Armature reaction and its effects.
1.7. Commutation
1.8. Parallel operation of DC generator.
1.9. Applications of DC generator.
uos: 1.a. Describe the construction of DC Machines with neat sketches.
1.b. Explain working principle of DC generator.
1.c. Classify DC generators with neat diagrams.
1.d. Explain the concept of voltage build up and losses.
1.e. Describe various characteristics of DC generator.
1.f. Describe armature reaction and commutation.
1.g. Explain requirement for Parallel operation of DC generator.
1.h. List the applications of DC Generator.

units.title: DC Motor
topics: 2.1. Basic principle of DC motor, Flemings left hand rule.
2.2. Back emf and voltage equation, condition for maximum power, torque relation, shaft torque, relation between torque and speed of motor, losses and efficiency.
2.3. Different characteristics of DC series, shunt and compound motor.
2.4. General applications of shunt, series, and compound motor.
uos: 2.a. Explain the working of DC motor.
2.b. Describe the concept of back emf, voltage equation, torque, speed, losses and efficiency.
2.c. Describe the behaviour of DC series, shunt and compound motor.
2.d. List the applications of D.C. Motors.

units.title: Starting, braking and speed control of DC motor.
topics: 3.1. Need of starter in DC motor, three-point, four point starter, supporting conventional resistance and static power electronics converter control.
3.2. Braking: dynamic, plugging, regenerative; shunt, series and compound motor.
3.3. Speed control method: armature, field
3.4. Speed control using power electronics static converter along with DC motor supporting static power electronics converter.
uos: 3.a. Describe starters used in DC Motor.
3.b. Explain different types of braking in DC motors.
3.c. Explain speed control methods of DC Motors.

units.title: Single phase Transformer
topics: 4.1. Construction: core type and shell type transformer

4.2. Classification: according to frequency groups, DC Machines & Transformer Course code: 3332401 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/12-13 Gujarat State 3 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (‘Course Outcomes’ in Cognitive Domain according to NBA terminology) Topics and Sub-topics mode of operations, purpose of usage and according to cooling systems.
4.3. Difference between ideal and practical transformer.
4.4. Diagram of exact and approximate equivalent circuit of single phase transformer.
4.5. Open-circuit and short circuit test for determining equivalent circuit parameters of single phase transformer.
4.6. Phasor diagram of transformer on no load, resistive, lagging pf and leading pf.

4.7. Iron and copper loss transformer, calculation of losses, voltage regulation of transformer, condition for zero and maximum regulation, efficiency and condition for maximum efficiency, all-day-efficiency( distribution transformer).
4.8. Essential and desirable conditions, polarity test and parallel operation on single phase transformers.
uos: 4.a. Classify the transformers based on different criteria.
4.b. Explain the concept of Ideal & practical transformer.
4.c. Differentiate exact and equivalent circuit
4.d. Derive performance parameters using OC and SC test.
4.e. Explain the phasor/ vector diagram with sketches.
4.f. Determine the various losses, performance indices viz., efficiency/all day- efficiency and voltage regulation etc.
4.g. Describe parallel operation of single phase transformer.

units.title: Three phase transformer
topics: 5.1. Star-star, star-delta, delta-star, delta-delta connection, Scott connection, input-output voltage and current relations for these connections.
5.2. Potential and current transformers.
5.3. Pulse transformer, and its input-output waveform.
5.4. Off-load and on load tap changing
5.5. Variable frequency transformer including mid- band, high and low frequency region.
5.6. Audio frequency transformer at different frequency response.
5.7. Applications of various transformer in the field of power electronics. DC Machines & Transformer Course code: 3332401 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/12-13 Gujarat State 4
uos: 5.a. Explain the three phase transformer connections with sketches.
5.b. Explain the working of Instrument transformers.
5.c. Explain the working of Pulse transformer.
5.d. Explain the working of Tap changing transformer.
5.e. Explain the working of variable frequency transformer.
5.f. Explain the working of audio-frequency transformer.
5.g. List the applications of the above transformers in the field of power electronics.
